context: Two teens chat about a haunted house event
purpose: Teach: 悲鳴/若き/のぞい/いただか/むろん/彦/晃/泰

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭のお化け屋敷、悲鳴がすごかった。
lines.en: The screams in the haunted house were seriously impressive.
lines.style: Bright, animated, leaning forward slightly. Genuine enthusiasm with no irony. Quick pace on the setup, slight emphasis on 'seriously' to convey the scale. Light and conversational.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 若き役者部、皆熱心だよな。
lines.en: The theater club kids are all really committed, aren't they?
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to himself. Slight smile in the voice. Relaxed, not performing. Acknowledgment without making it a big deal. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 裏からのぞいた瞬間、しかけが見えた。
lines.en: I snuck a peek from backstage and saw right through their whole setup.
lines.style: Wry, self-satisfied smirk in the voice. Light and teasing. Quick delivery on 'saw right through' — knows she's being a bit smug about it. Trailing amusement.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 参加賞、いただかなかった?
lines.en: You didn't grab a prize for checking it out?
lines.style: Curious probe, genuinely interested in the answer. Slight tilt in his voice like he's testing if she's holding something back. Warm but not leading. Open-ended.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: むろん貰ったよ。担当の彦先輩からね。
lines.en: Of course I did — Hiko-senpai gave me one.
lines.style: Satisfied and bright. Quick, assured answer. Slight warmth when mentioning Hiko-senpai's name — comfort with someone she trusts. Matter-of-fact but pleased with herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 隣のクラスの晃も、お化け役だった。
lines.en: Akira from the next class was one of the ghosts.
lines.style: Casual mention, like he's thinking out loud. No particular weight on it. Slow, easy pace. Testing if she's interested or if this lands differently for her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 準備の泰先輩、徹夜で頑張ってたって。
lines.en: Yasushi-senpai — the one who handled setup — apparently pulled an all-nighter for it.
lines.style: Quiet respect underneath. Slower pace, slight sober tone. Trailing off gently at the end, like the weight of that effort settles on her. Noticing something beyond the fun.
